_note: Curated from public reporting on district problems; needs confirmation by a local partner (Atal Tinkering Labs, district innovation cells, NGOs) before being presented as a live project.

local_opportunities.title: Early detection of coconut pest attack with low-cost drones
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Coconut groves around Pollachi lose yield to rugose whitefly and red palm weevil; detection is manual and late.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Collect 300 labelled leaf photos from 3 farms and train a phone-based classifier.

local_opportunities.title: Energy-efficient pump sets for MSME foundries and farms
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Coimbatore's pump and motor cluster lacks affordable efficiency testing for small units.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Build an Arduino power logger and benchmark 5 pump sets with a local workshop.

local_opportunities.title: Low-cost textile effluent monitoring
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Dyeing units around Tiruppur need cheap, continuous water-quality monitoring for compliance.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Prototype a pH/TDS sensor buoy and publish a weekly open-data dashboard.

local_opportunities.title: Street-level flood reporting during the monsoon
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Low-lying Chennai neighbourhoods flood every monsoon; residents lack real-time street-level information.
local_opportunities.partner_type: Greater Chennai Corporation & resident welfare associations
local_opportunities.starter_project: Map flood-prone streets in your ward from 50 resident reports and share the map with the ward office.

local_opportunities.title: Keeping Madurai jasmine fresh from farm to market
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Madurai malli loses value within hours; small growers cannot afford cold storage.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Test three low-cost evaporative cooling boxes and measure flower freshness over 24 hours.

local_opportunities.title: Tracking falling groundwater and fluoride in village wells
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Dharmapuri villages face falling water tables and high fluoride; data on individual wells is scarce.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Test 20 village wells for fluoride with a kit and publish a simple village water map.

local_opportunities.title: Grading mangoes and millets for better prices
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Small farmers sell ungraded produce at low prices; simple grading could raise income.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Photograph 200 mangoes, define three grades with farmers, and build a sorting checklist.

local_opportunities.title: Citizen monitoring of Bengaluru's lakes
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Lakes suffer sewage inflow and foaming; volunteer groups need affordable, regular water data.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Measure dissolved oxygen in one lake weekly for two months and publish the trend.

local_opportunities.title: Smarter junctions for buses and pedestrians
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Bus delays and unsafe crossings at busy junctions; signal timings rarely use real counts.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Count pedestrians and buses at one junction for a week and propose a revised signal plan.

local_opportunities.title: Heat-wave shelters and cool roofs
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Summer heat hits informal workers hardest; cool-roof trials need temperature evidence.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Log indoor temperatures under painted and unpainted roofs for a month and compare.

local_opportunities.title: Where should neighbourhood EV chargers go?
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Two-wheeler EV adoption is rising faster than charging access in housing societies.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Survey 100 EV owners in your area and map demand for shared chargers.

local_opportunities.title: Mapping mangrove loss with satellite images
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Mangroves protect Mumbai from storm surges but are cut and dumped on.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Compare free satellite images from 2016 and 2026 for one creek and estimate change.

local_opportunities.title: Low-cost air-quality sensors near schools
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Winter pollution peaks near schools and traffic corridors; official monitors are far apart.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Calibrate a low-cost PM2.5 sensor against a government monitor and run it at your school.

local_opportunities.title: Recycling textile offcuts from garment units
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Garment units discard tonnes of fabric offcuts; small recyclers lack sorting methods.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Collect offcuts from two units, sort by fibre, and design one product from them.

local_opportunities.title: Eye and lung safety in small diamond-polishing units
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Polishers work long hours with dust and glare; cheap protective setups are rare.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Survey 30 workers on eye strain and test one low-cost lighting change.

local_opportunities.title: Tracking coastal erosion in fishing villages
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Erosion is destroying homes along the coast; families need evidence for planning.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Photograph the same 10 shoreline points monthly and measure retreat.

local_opportunities.title: Online markets for Bengal handloom weavers
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Weavers earn little because middlemen control access to buyers.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Build an online catalogue for one cooperative with 20 products and fair prices.

local_opportunities.title: Reviving step-wells and rooftop water harvesting
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Groundwater is falling; old step-wells and rooftop harvesting are neglected.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Measure rooftop area and rainfall for your school and design a harvesting plan.

local_opportunities.title: Alternatives to burning crop stubble
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Stubble burning harms air and soil; farmers need cheap alternatives.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Trial composting stubble with a decomposer on one plot and compare soil results.

local_opportunities.title: Reducing fish spoilage for small boats
local_opportunities.problem_statement: Small-boat fishers lose catch to spoilage before it reaches the market.
local_opportunities.starter_project: Test an insulated ice box design on three boats and measure fish temperature on landing.
